name: Joumana Al Nounou
title: Senior Arabic broadcast journalist and media trainer
bio_short: Senior Arabic broadcast journalist and media trainer with more than 20 years' experience. Chief editor and news anchor at Al Mashhad TV. Trains executives and spokespeople in Arabic media performance, public speaking and crisis media.
bio: Joumana is a senior Arabic broadcast journalist and media trainer with more than 20 years' experience in television, radio and digital media. She is currently chief editor and senior news anchor at Al Mashhad TV, where she leads editorial teams and anchors major news programming. Her career spans newsrooms across the Arab world, including senior presenting and editorial roles at AlAan TV, Al Ekhbariya in Saudi Arabia, Kuwait TV and Live Point.  Alongside her broadcasting career, Joumana has spent more than a decade as a media trainer. She delivers training in Arabic media performance, TV and radio presenting, public speaking, voiceover and strategic media engagement. Her training clients include Dubai Chambers, Abu Dhabi Development Fund, General Motors, OQ in Oman, New Murabba in Riyadh, Saudi Investment Bank, Riyadh Bank, Zahid Group, Matarat Holding and Ajman Free Zone Authority. She also lectures in media at two UAE universities.  At ISOC, Joumana delivers Arabic-language media training and public speaking programmes for executives and spokespeople. Her current role as a working news anchor means her training reflects the demands of today's Arabic media landscape. Joumana is based in Dubai and trains in Arabic and English.
bio_long: Joumana is a senior Arabic broadcast journalist and media trainer with more than 20 years' experience in television, radio and digital media. She is currently chief editor and senior news anchor at Al Mashhad TV, where she leads teams of scriptwriters and researchers and anchors major news programming. Her career spans newsrooms across the Arab world, including senior presenting and editorial roles at AlAan TV in the UAE, Al Ekhbariya in Saudi Arabia, Kuwait TV and Live Point, where she served as editorial quality assurance manager for TV, radio and online content.  Alongside her broadcasting career, Joumana has spent more than a decade as a media trainer. She delivers training in Arabic media performance, TV and radio presenting, public speaking, voiceover, strategic media engagement and crisis communication. Her training clients include Dubai Chambers, Abu Dhabi Development Fund, SHAMS Abu Dhabi, General Motors, FedEx, OQ in Oman, New Murabba in Riyadh, Saudi Investment Bank, Riyadh Bank, Zahid Group, Matarat Holding and Ajman Free Zone Authority. She also lectures in media and communication at UAE universities including Umm Al Quwain University and Al Falah University.  At ISOC, Joumana delivers Arabic-language media training and public speaking programmes for executives and spokespeople across government, energy, financial services and real estate. Her focus on Arabic media excellence makes her a distinctive asset for organisations that need their spokespeople to perform at the highest level in Arabic-language media. Joumana is based in Dubai and trains in Arabic and English. She holds certifications in digital journalism from Reuters and AFP/Google and has been recognised by UNESCO's Women Make News programme.
